beats.title: A bank, and the four tools that run it
beats.say: Everything here is simulated: 400 applications, and the systems its IT teams use every day.

beats.title: A normal afternoon
beats.say: Logs flow in and nothing is wrong. The agent is learning what normal looks like.

beats.title: A routine change ships
beats.say: Changes go to production all day. One of them is about to break something.

beats.title: Errors appear
beats.say: Within seconds the agent notices the spike and opens a case. No alert has fired yet.

beats.title: Then the alerts start
beats.say: Each alert is on a different application. This is when people would start getting paged.

beats.title: One problem, not dozens
beats.say: 7 applications are failing. The agent works out they are the same problem and keeps one case.

beats.title: How bad is it?
beats.say: Claude reads the logs and the application catalog, and sizes it up.

beats.title: It opens the incident
beats.say: Priority is set, and it goes straight to the team that owns the suspect application.

beats.title: Tickets about the same problem are grouped under it
beats.say: Branch staff called the help desk about this too. Their 2 tickets now sit under this one incident.

beats.title: It brings in the right people
beats.say: 8 people in one Teams channel, each told why they are there.

beats.title: And briefs them
beats.say: One message: impact, timeline, the leading suspect and links to the evidence.

beats.title: It finds the cause
beats.say: Claude read the diffs and the code, and names the change responsible.

beats.title: This is the change
beats.say: It passed review, and the service it changed never returned an error itself.

beats.title: It writes the fix
beats.say: A merge request with the fix, explaining the cause and the evidence.

beats.title: Your turn: merge it
beats.say: This decision stays with a person. The agent cannot merge, on purpose.

beats.title: Merged
beats.say: This decision stays with a person. The agent cannot merge, on purpose.

beats.title: It ships the fix to production
beats.say: An emergency change request, raised by the agent and promoted by the release system.

beats.title: Then checks it actually worked
beats.say: Errors on the affected applications: 805 a minute before the fix, 112 now.

beats.title: All clear
beats.say: The agent tells the channel it is fixed, and writes up the resolution.

beats.title: First error to fixed
beats.say: The agent did the legwork. A person made the one decision that mattered.
